description: Policy binding (spec §8). A policy item is a live item payload with meta.kind "policy", value "" and meta exactly {kind, item_ids, policy}: item_ids (1..1024 unique item IDs, never its own) names the items it governs, policy is the §8 policy object, and the payload sensitivity is the minimum sensitivity it imposes. expected = resolveItemPolicy(target, items): policy is the intersection of every governing policy (max_ttl_s min, require_approval OR, allowed_* intersected, deny_agents united, text dropped; lists keep first-occurrence order, policies taken in the byte order of their base64url item_id strings) or null; sensitivity is high when any live record of the target or any governing policy item is high; grant = effectiveGrant(local, policy, sensitivity). items lists every item the device holds: its head and unresolved conflict branches, each {tombstone, payload} with payload null when the device could not open the record. invalid: the device MUST refuse release with expect_error, never fall back to the local grant alone. Checks run in spec §8.1 order: shape (bad_request); an unopenable record anywhere is decrypt_failed (a policy moved from another vault, item.json moved_to_other_vault, lands here); payloads (bad_request); the binding (value, meta keys, item_ids) of every policy anywhere (bad_request); the target (bad_request); a policy naming the target on an item with unresolved conflict branches is conflict; the policy body of every governing policy (bad_request). The body of a policy that does not name the target is not checked. A replayed older policy revision never reaches items (records.json replayed_older_revision).
